hub.actions.title: What would you like to do?
hub.tabs.title: Shirt hub
hub.filters.title: Filters
hub.empty.title: Nothing open matches that yet.
hub.empty.body: Save the search and we'll tell you when a copy opens — or put up a request so the people who hold one can find you.
hub.searches.guestHint: Sign in and we'll tell you when a match opens.
hub.searches.saved: Saved. We'll tell you when a matching copy opens.
hub.searches.title: Your searches
hub.searches.empty: Filter the market down to what you want, then tap "Tell me when one opens". It lives here.
hub.wanted.title: Collectors are looking for these
hub.wanted.lede: A request shows the shirt, the size and how they'd like to get it — never a budget, never a name. If you hold the shirt, tell them; the rest happens in a conversation.
hub.wanted.withdrawn: Your request is off the board. It's still yours, privately.
hub.wanted.emptyTitle: No requests on the board yet.
hub.wanted.emptyBody: Be the first: say which shirt you're after and holders will find you.
hub.request.title: I'm looking for a shirt
hub.request.lede: Pick the shirt, say what you'd like. The budget stays private to you.
hub.request.search: Club, season or kit — e.g. "Olympiacos 1998 away"
hub.request.noShirt: No shirt in the archive matches that.
hub.request.notePlaceholder: e.g. Prefer the one with the sponsor intact
hub.request.budgetPrivate: Only you see this. It is never shown on the board or to anyone you talk to.
hub.request.public: Show it on the wanted board
hub.request.publicOn: Shirt, size and note are public; you appear as a numbered collector.
hub.request.publicOff: Private: we'll only alert you when a copy opens.
hub.request.savedPublic: Your request is on the wanted board.
hub.request.savedPrivate: Saved privately. We'll tell you when a copy opens.
hub.mine.title: Shirts you're after
hub.mine.empty: Nothing yet. Say which shirt you're looking for and the market will watch for it.
hub.foryou.guestTitle: Sign in to see what the market found for you
hub.foryou.guestBody: Matches, saved searches and your requests live in your account — one Google sign-in, and the market stays open to everyone.
hub.deal.title: The deal
hub.deal.bundleTitle: Bundle: more than one copy from this seller
hub.deal.bundleBody: Name one price for several of their copies. They can accept, decline or counter — a counter stays a bundle.
hub.deal.bundleNone: This seller has no other copies open right now.
hub.deal.handoverBody: Agree how it changes hands. Either of you can set it; the other sees it at once.
hub.deal.sentMine: I've handed over / posted my part
hub.deal.sentMineDone: You marked your part as sent.
hub.deal.sentTheirs: They say their part is on its way.
hub.deal.reminder: When you both have what you came for, press “Deal complete” above. FAN LIFE takes no fee and does not handle money or parcels.
hub.deal.feedbackBody: Only counts are public. Your note is read by them alone.
hub.where.setPlace: Say where you are to filter by who can ship to you
hub.place.title: Where are you?
hub.place.lede: Optional. If you show it, your copies say where they are and you can find sellers who ship to you. If you don't, nobody sees anything.
hub.place.show: Show my country and city on my copies
hub.place.hidden: Saved, but hidden — only you know it.
hub.circles.title: Circles
hub.circles.lede: A circle is a way of looking at the same market: one club, one country, one city. Following one puts what's new in it in your pipe. Nothing here is a chat — it's shirts.
hub.circles.countriesLede: Only collectors who chose to show their country are counted.
hub.circles.empty: Nothing listed yet. When someone opens a copy, the clubs and countries appear here.
hub.circles.signIn: Sign in to follow circles and to say where you are.
hub.circle.title: {name}
hub.circle.empty: Nothing open in this circle right now. Follow it and you'll hear when the first copy lands.
hub.copies.title: How far your copies travel
hub.copies.lede: Pick how each copy can travel. “My country” needs your place above; “Anywhere” puts it in front of buyers abroad.
hub.copies.none: You have no copies open for sale or swap.
hub.copies.shipNo: This copy is set to meet-up only.
hub.pipe.title: Your pipe
hub.pipe.lede: What the market has for you right now, nearest first. No scores — each line says why it's here.
hub.pipe.foundEmpty: Nothing on your list is open right now. Add a request and the pipe starts looking.
hub.pipe.answersEmpty: None of your open copies answers a public request today.
hub.pipe.clubs: New in the clubs you follow
hub.pipe.noClubs: Follow a club circle to see what lands in it.
hub.pipe.responded: They've been told you have it.
hub.pipe.signIn: Sign in to open your pipe.
hub.help.title: What shirt is this?
hub.help.lede: Found something in a drawer or a box and can't say what it is? Post photos. People who know will suggest the shirt from the archive, and you choose the one that fits.
hub.help.notePlaceholder: Where it came from, the colour of the badge, any numbers on the label…
hub.help.club: Which club do you think it is? (optional)
hub.help.sent: Posted. You'll be told when someone suggests a shirt.
hub.help.noMine: You haven't asked about a shirt yet.
hub.help.suggestSent: Thank you — the asker has been told.
hub.help.seeShirt: See this shirt in the market
hub.help.signIn: Sign in to ask, or to suggest a shirt.
hub.help.photoFailed: A photo didn't upload. Try again.
hub.hero.title: Shirt Market
hub.search.label: Search the market
hub.search.empty: No copy matches “{q}”. Try fewer words, or clear the search.
hub.wantedStrip.title: Wanted
hub.item.signInToAct: Sign in to make an offer or ask a question.
